text_elements.content:
THE FIRST 20 MILLION
BITCOIN TOOK 17 YEARS TO MINE.

THE LAST MILLION
WILL TAKE 114 YEARS

progress_bar.length_comparison: longer on the left, shorter on the right

description: The meme conveys a humorous comparison of the time it takes to mine the first 20 million bitcoins versus the last million, illustrated with a character observing a progress bar.
